crossRefs.note: However I will not tear away all the kingdom; but I will give one tribe to your son, for David my servant’s sake, and…
I will give one tribe to his son, that David my servant may have a lamp always before me in Jerusalem, the city which I…
But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel stood with him out of all their territory.
